response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_above_average FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg
